description.value: Dominion Cider Co. is a small-batch craft cidery in Summerland, BC, producing wild-fermented ciders from locally sourced Okanagan apples, pears, and fruits. Their seasonal tasting room features a scenic picnic area where visitors can bring their own food and sample everything from refreshing classics to bold experimental blends. The dog-friendly setting and bring-your-own-picnic format make it a relaxed and welcoming stop for cyclists riding the Okanagan valley.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content is available and confirms an active craft cidery with a seasonal tasting room in Summerland, BC. Key amenity evidence comes from the 'What to Expect' tasting room section (picnic area, dog-friendly, cider to take home) and a product page (gluten free label on Magic Hour). OSM community tag says 'Naramata' but the website explicitly states 'Located in Summerland, BC', which is flagged as a concern. No bike parking, washrooms, or water refill are mentioned anywhere on the site.
